mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining GDP, or GDP growth and SPX returns show no significant negative correlation (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased construction activity boosts economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% per month, it signals a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded and borrowing costs increase.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a significant economic downturn, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in the same period
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of negative GDP growth and increasing UNRATE on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
